what: OU7's full rehearsal: every Lean file the kit's apply and both stages change or add, at its package path, with every module of the package downstream of them and the root (376 targets; their import closure, 383 modules), built by the package's scratch_build.py outside the repository, inside the coordinator's gate. A working build, not a receipt: the environment audit, the controls, the prelude-only compile and the core receipt are the landing's core run, which reuses every step that passed here.

gate.rule: the coordinator's: the 5-minute load under 24, memory_pressure at least 40% free, and fewer than two Lean runs (pgrep -f 'toolchains/.*/bin/lean', which matches Lean processes only), checked every minute until met

scope: Every module downstream of the changes, not only Persistence and the modules importing Identity (214 with the changed modules): the landing's core run rebuilds all of them, so the machine time is the same either way, the landing reuses every step, and a break outside Identity's cone (an old name of 20-nd's) shows here. OU's owner and the coordinator agreed.

base.note: The dry run's tree on main at 9a01af14e (ca73609f8, EL landed, is in it), this branch at 9ea63b384 merged with it, after prepare and apply with both stages in place: the kit's patches, the owner's 01-04, the three leaves and their joins, then 10-u4c's 33 patches and 20-nd's 43, patch by patch. Its synthetic receipt (20261101T032611.121204Z) recorded each changed source's hash right after apply. Main has since moved by documents only (the collective page's text-review fixes, OPENING's version 13) up to UE28's head claim 1f1bbb543.

Its 17 declarations with propext and Quot.sound are exactly those of its own receipt (fallible-inquiry-verification.json, 20261031T130828.999853Z, 31 theorems in 37 declarations, layer 'periphery bridge'). No core or ring module has an axiom.
